posts.title: Your system drive is under 15% free space

slides.text:
Your system drive is under 15% free
A full drive crawls no matter how new the PC is.
WHY IT'S A PROBLEM — A full drive crawls no matter how new the PC is.
THE FIX — Settings > Storage > Temporary files — clear it, then empty the Recycle Bin.
Save this before it costs you a repair bill.

posts.title: More VRAM is all that matters

slides.text: More VRAM is all that matters
THE TRUTH — Memory bandwidth, the cooler and sustained TGP matter as much as raw VRAM. A high-wattage lower-tier GPU often beats a low-power version of a higher tier.
Share this with the person who still believes it.
